hints.title: Forced Substring Placement
hints.text: Every index where str1 is T forces the exact characters of str2 to appear at that window. Verify character consistency across overlapping windows.

hints.title: Greedy Fill with Smallest Characters
hints.text: Fill all unassigned characters with the smallest letter a to keep the result lexicographically minimal.

hints.title: F-Constraint Resolution
hints.text: Whenever an F window matches str2, break the match by changing the rightmost unfixed character in that window to b.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Copies matching patterns and resolves violations across n windows of length m.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking over all unassigned characters results in exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy assignment and rightmost modification preserves lexicographical order in deterministic linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforce mandatory patterns first, fill remaining greedily, and fix negative constraints locally.
